newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to float 30 pct of fertiliser firm's stock.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to float 30 pct of fertiliser firm's stock.

text.p: Morocco plans to float 30 percent of FERTIMA fertiliser company at 120 million dirhams ($13.7 million) on the bourse in October, an official at the privatisation ministry said on Friday.
"We plan to put 30 percent of FERTIMA's stock on the Casablanca stock exchange next month. The subscription will be opened to the general public," the official said.

Morocco's major fertiliser packing and distribution company, FERTIMA has a capital of 400 million dirhams. The state-owned Office Cherifien des Phosphates (OCP) holds a majority stake. ($ = 8.737 Moroccan Dirhams)
